gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

discardCards.title: Panzer Run
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Networking
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Psychic Friend
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

discardCards.title: Superglue
discardCards.rulesText: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Boostergang Connections
discardCards.rulesText: Trash your hand. Search your stack for as many cards as were successfully trashed in this way and bring them into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterward.

discardCards.title: Omnitech Wet Drive
discardCards.rulesText: Your base MU is equal to the number of cards in your hand instead of 4.

discardCards.title: Do the 'Drine
discardCards.rulesText: Suffer any amount of brain damage, but not enough to flatline you or to reduce your hand size to less than 0. Gain [4] for each point of brain damage you suffer in this way. This damage cannot be prevented.

discardCards.title: Library Search
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

discardCards.title: Corruption
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you scored any agendas this turn. Lose all agenda points you scored this turn, and the Corp scores that many agenda points. Gain [10] per agenda point lost in this way, and the Corp gives you a tag.
